prose: This epic conversation with Beth Martens is one of my favorite guest spots ever. Really enjoying all the interviews I’ve done on other shows lately, and thanks to great hosts like Beth, my rhetoric is getting sharper at describing Reality.
Make sure you give this great host Beth a sub on YouTube, and if you like her perspectives check out her book too. ⚡️
topics: My backstory and journey to podcasting
The light and dark side of music festivals and counter culture
The definition of Reality and what it means to be life-affirming
The ring (circle) and ring (resonance) of Truth and how to witness it
Archons, ancestors, demons, angels, and our relation to the archetypes within
The electric nature of life and our biofield
The two creation stories of man in Genesis
links: Video version on Beth Martens' YouTube channel
